The '''S<nowiki>'</nowiki>rai plant''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. This plant produced a dark brown nectar, which was used to paint [[vor'shandi]] face markings.
